Remark
[Strict positivity from boundary data]

↗ thm:strong-maximum-principle-laplace

1. ch2:2.2.3-rem-2\group Maximum Principles

If $U$ is connected, $u\in C^2(U)\cap C(\overline U)$ is harmonic, and its boundary data are nonnegative and positive somewhere, then $u>0$ throughout $U$.
